news.title: Reddit aims to make ‘karma’ less important for first-time posters with shift to AI moderation tools
news.summary: Reddit is expanding its moderation tools and building stronger abuse prevention systems that it says could eventually reduce communities’ reliance on karma and account-age requirements, making it easier for legitimate newcomers to participate.

news.title: PSA: Apple’s Private Relay can leak your real IP address

news.title: Google’s Top AI Brains Are Leaving to Launch Discovery Loop
news.summary: Jeff Dean and other high-profile Google executives have founded Discovery Loop, a startup that will seek AI-powered breakthroughs in everything from drug discovery to chip design.

news.title: MAGA Is In Turmoil Over Tucker Carlson’s Possible 2028 Presidential Bid
